knowledge.title: Backend Development
knowledge.content: GrowthsStack.Dev specializes in backend development using Python, FastAPI, Docker, PostgreSQL, Redis, REST APIs, GraphQL, OAuth, JWT authentication, cloud infrastructure, and scalable system architecture.

knowledge.title: Backend Architecture
knowledge.content: Backend systems are designed with scalability, modular architecture, clean code, API-first development, microservices where appropriate, security, maintainability, and high performance in mind.

knowledge.title: Python Development
knowledge.content: Python is the primary backend programming language used to develop AI systems, APIs, automation tools, SaaS platforms, business software, and enterprise applications.

knowledge.title: FastAPI
knowledge.content: FastAPI is used for building modern, high-performance APIs with automatic documentation, async support, validation, dependency injection, and excellent scalability.

knowledge.title: Databases
knowledge.content: Supported databases include PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Supabase, Firebase, SQLite, and vector databases depending on project requirements.

knowledge.title: Authentication
knowledge.content: Authentication systems support JWT, OAuth, Google Login, GitHub Login, Microsoft Login, role-based access control, refresh tokens, and secure session management.

knowledge.title: API Development
knowledge.content: Backend systems expose secure REST APIs and GraphQL APIs with rate limiting, validation, versioning, logging, monitoring, documentation, and webhook support.

knowledge.title: Caching
knowledge.content: Redis is used for caching, background jobs, queues, sessions, rate limiting, and improving application performance.

knowledge.title: Deployment
knowledge.content: Applications are containerized using Docker and deployed on AWS, Azure, Railway, Render, VPS, DigitalOcean, or other cloud providers.

knowledge.title: Security
knowledge.content: Backend security includes HTTPS, password hashing, JWT, OAuth, RBAC, CORS, environment variables, encrypted secrets, audit logs, backups, and secure API design.

knowledge.title: AI Integration
knowledge.content: Backend systems integrate with OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Llama, vector databases, RAG pipelines, and AI agents.

knowledge.title: Monitoring
knowledge.content: Production systems include logging, monitoring, error tracking, health checks, performance metrics, alerts, and automated backups.

faqs.question: Do you build backend systems?
faqs.answer: Yes. GrowthsStack.Dev develops secure, scalable, and high-performance backend systems using Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, and cloud technologies.

faqs.question: Which backend framework do you use?
faqs.answer: FastAPI is the primary backend framework because of its speed, scalability, async support, and automatic API documentation.

faqs.question: Do you use Python?
faqs.answer: Yes. Python is the primary language for backend systems, AI development, APIs, automation, and SaaS platforms.

faqs.question: Can you build REST APIs?
faqs.answer: Yes. Secure REST APIs with authentication, validation, logging, versioning, and documentation are supported.

faqs.question: Do you support GraphQL?
faqs.answer: Yes. GraphQL APIs can be developed depending on the project requirements.

faqs.question: Which databases do you use?
faqs.answer: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, SQLite, Supabase, Firebase, and vector databases are supported.

faqs.question: Can you integrate AI into backend systems?
faqs.answer: Yes. AI models, RAG pipelines, OpenAI APIs, vector databases, and AI agents can be integrated.

faqs.question: Can you deploy backend applications?
faqs.answer: Yes. Applications can be deployed using Docker on AWS, Azure, Railway, Render, VPS, and DigitalOcean.

faqs.question: How do you secure backend applications?
faqs.answer: Security includes JWT authentication, OAuth, HTTPS, password hashing, RBAC, CORS, logging, monitoring, backups, and secure API design.

faqs.question: Can you optimize backend performance?
faqs.answer: Yes. Redis caching, async processing, optimized database queries, Docker, and scalable architecture improve backend performance.
